 Match Preview
 AFC Champions League Elite - Game Week 4 2 Nov 2026 - 10:00 Al-Wasl and Al Quwa Al Jawiya meet in the AFC Champions League Elite, with both clubs looking to strengthen their positions in the West group standings.
 Rui Vitoria's Al-Wasl come into this fixture under pressure. Two defeats in their last three AFC Champions League Elite outings have left them deep in the bottom half of the group, and they need a result to keep their continental ambitions alive.
 Al Quwa Al Jawiya arrive in better continental form. The Iraqi side picked up a win over Pakhtakor Tashkent in their most recent AFC Champions League Elite fixture, giving Fathi Al Jabal's squad genuine momentum heading into this match.
 Neither side has been entirely consistent across all competitions. Al-Wasl have mixed domestic solidity with continental struggles, while Al Quwa Al Jawiya have drawn two of their last three games in the Iraqi Premier League.
 With both teams needing points to move in the right direction in the West group, this fixture carries real weight for their respective knockout round hopes.
